SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination as the learner will generate new ideas as they brainstorm on different forms of distractions

and how to avoid them.

● Communication and collaboration as the learner will listen critically and show awareness of the speaker, context and

intention in varied oral texts.

Values:
● Responsibility is promoted as the learners engage in assigned duties and roles as they collaboratively search for

information online and offline on how to identify the speaker, context and intention.

● Love is enhanced as the learner portrays a caring attitude as they brainstorm different forms of distractions and how to

avoid them.
